reserved.reason: Maya custom component and independent rotate/scale pivots need transient transform-center data. Blender Object Origins Only mutates object origin and cannot stand in for the Maya pivot tool. No equivalent pivot capability is present.
Existing Blender GRID snapping can be held temporarily. Maya sets grid on then off; restoration of prior Blender settings is an explicit adaptation.
Existing Blender VERTEX snapping can be held temporarily. Target and transform behavior remain native.
Maya toggles incremental snapping on both press/release; Shift+J additionally toggles relative mode. Blender increment settings and units differ.
Blender EDGE snapping follows mesh edges and is not Maya closest point on arbitrary parametric curves. No equivalent curve-target solver is implemented; do not relabel EDGE as curve snap.
UV selection domain and synchronized viewport UV editing are deferred; mapping F12 to face selection or opening UV Editor would not implement the Maya selection mask.
Maya base/cage/smooth mesh preview needs nondestructive per-object preview state; not equivalent to changing selection mode.
Cage plus smooth preview needs managed preview state. Silently adding/changing subdivision modifiers is outside the GUI-only scope.
Smooth preview and restoring previous state need a preview capability, not an arbitrary Subdivision modifier command.
